title: Stonemason
author: achats57
changes: Real recording of a stonemason tapping a chisel into stone with a hammer (four taps), used for the fossil because it sounds like a fossil dig. Trimmed to 18.50–19.85 s of the original, mixed to mono, silence trimmed, loudness-normalised (≈ −18 dBFS RMS, peak ≤ −1 dBFS), peaks limited by 2.0 dB, 10 ms fade-in / 120 ms fade-out, encoded as 96 kbps mono MP3. Taken from the Freesound high-quality MP3 preview of the recording, made outdoors in rural Wales. No high-pass is applied because the clip has no measurable low-frequency rumble.
